queries.milestones: SELECT ms_no AS milestone_id, project_code AS project, customer AS client, amount AS value_inr, completion_date AS signoff_date, billed_date AS invoice_date FROM v_milestones WHERE completion_date >= :since
queries.ap_invoices: SELECT doc_no AS invoice_id, vendor_name AS vendor, bill_no AS invoice_no, bill_date AS invoice_date, amount AS amount_inr, payment_date AS paid_date FROM v_ap WHERE bill_date >= :since
